text:
# meta.feedId

TL;DR:
- meta.feedId provides feed context for feed-driven search execution.

What it means:
- It carries feed surface context rather than acting as a plain filter on listing content.

Agent hint:
- Prefer filter.feedId or filter.feedIdIn when the request is explicitly about constraining results by feed. Use meta.feedId when the execution context itself is feed-driven.
